test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 7 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which flagship programme guarantees 100 days of wage employment in a year to every household?

options.text: Mahatama Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)

solution:
The correct answer is__** Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA).**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **MGNREGA** was enacted in **2005** and is one of** the largest public works programmes in the world.**
 
• The act guarantees **100 days of wage employment** in a financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.
 
• The programme aims to enhance **livelihood security in rural areas and improve the purchasing power of rural households.**
 
• MGNREGA also focuses on creating durable assets in rural areas, such as **roads, canals, and ponds, thus contributing to rural development.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Objectives**: The primary objective of MGNREGA is to provide a safety net for rural households by guaranteeing employment and improving their livelihoods.
 
• **Implementation**: The act is implemented through a decentralized system, with local self-governments playing a significant role in planning and executing works.
 
• Launched in 2006 in Uttar Pradesh, primarily implemented by gram panchayats (village councils).
 
• Unemployment Allowance: If work is not provided within 15 days of applying, applicants are entitled to an unemployment allowance.
 
• **Impact**: MGNREGA has led to a reduction in rural poverty, improved social equity, and enhanced rural infrastructure.
 
• **Monitoring**: The programme includes provisions for transparency and accountability, with social audits and public disclosures to ensure effective implementation.
